notes.title: UPDATE #14 Late, but dynamic
notes.content:
Hello, people!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/d72c05b3c77ab32845eaf60a637882467163dcb5.gif[/img]
First of all, I apologize for delay between previous and this update. 
I was ill and that's why it took me more time to work on new stuff. That's why I came to the decision that it is better not to put deadlines. It will allow me to work deeply without worrying about dates. That's why new updates might be released without schedule.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/4d61d686372a788fb835abdcd86f4c0491190812.gif[/img]
Anyway, I brought you a lot today. :)

[h1]What is new:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Alternative individual shooting modes for every weapon which can be used by right click of the mouse. 
[*]Short range attack for pistol.
[*]Different shooting mode for rifle.
[*]Long range mode for flamethrower.
[*]Very cool middle range attack for grenade launcher (look at the top gif :) )
[*]Rocket launcher alternative shoot allows to make attack area more accurate
[*]Small fix of control's help at the beginning of the levels.
[*]Small graphic changes
[*]Bugfixes
[/list]

Overall, those alternative shooting modes makes battle gameplay more deep.
For instance, pistol now is noticeably effective on close ranges. Riffle might be used to spam enemies' attacks (very effective against artillery)
Now different weapons allow to truly control enemy on different ranges and eliminate it in most effective ways. :)

[h1]Other news[/h1]
Also, I've released my new small game which I was developing between updates. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32901970/e19d887a79436293035b374f40891feccb1ad788.gif[/img]
After such a big amount of brutal violence and bloody sights, it would be great heal for your nerves :D 
I hope, you will also enjoy it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/868230/Mushroom_Quest/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/868230/Mushroom_Quest/[/url]

Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: UPDATE #13 Unexpected, but lovely
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/ca26bcf2ee2241354b65854b6ec712c32870751c.gif[/img]

Long time no see, guys! :)

I apologize for long delay in updates. Had some stuff IRL to do which I completed and now I can finally continue development. 

As you can read in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/542400/announcements/detail/1593577406729941395] Update 12 [/url] , I was planning to stop making updates. Actually, it was because I was starting the development of Pixel Gladiator 2. The sequel is planned to be even more bigger, even more fun. It was in the stage of planning (and it is still there). However, there are some other projects which I want to publish so I decided to complete them before starting active phase of the development. 

In order to not make you wait too much without new content, I decided to start making constant updates again. :)

Therefore, meet the new update of Pixel Gladiator. *o*
The updates add to the game new random event - attack of red robots. They are fast and furious, be ready to jump a lot and shoot nonstop. :D

Except this, the update mostly provides minor changes and bug-fixes which had been complete since the last update. 

New updates will add unique constructions, items and (maybe) unique gameplay changes.

I will try to add new updates every 1-2 weeks, but more likely every 2-3 weeks.

Stay in touch!
:D

[b]P.S.[/b] I created new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/542400/discussions/0/2561864094347787206/] thread [/url] in discussions where you guys may tell what you want to see in future updates. If you have some unique suggestions and bright ideas - feel free to tell them to us, I can't guarantee that they will be implemented but I will surely take them into consideration.

Hello, people! 

Meet the new update of Pixel Gladiator!
For the coming Halloween, I've packed some cool stuff.

What is new:
-Bright new random encounter - death parade (look at gif)
-4 new unique enemies (I recommend you to kill ghosts first, walls won't stop them :) )
-3 new items and 1 helmet (pumpkin helmet, yay!) :)

-New sounds
-Bug-fixes (more content = more bugs, ugh=C)

Also, I prepared a gift for you!
If you enter the survival mode between 21 October and 7 November you will get pumpkin helmet! :)

Thank you for the attention!

notes.title: UPDATE #7 MEGA-UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello, buddies! New update is released!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/fed47bb498da1e000e0cc44b5df75a59f0c121b7.gif[/img]
Long time no see. I have been preparing a lot of new content for this update. I hope you enjoy it.

What is new?
-New random encounter with army of aggressive slimes.
-2 absolutely new bosses with special attacks and minions
-Now in survival mode each 10 wave comes boss randomly out of 3. 
  Many people mentioned that it would be great to add bosses in survival mode too. That is why I added them. Now survival mode became even more interesting! :)
-Small bugfixes, as always 
-Some new sounds
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/f296363c21df6e6135263edee3c9db0106a13bdd.png[/img]
 
Actually, I added all planned in-game content to the game. In future there will be more polishing of current version of the game. In next update I will try to add controller support (There is a problem of usability of controller with current interface). 

Stay with us, release is soon! 
Thank you for your attention! 

;)

notes.title: UPDATE #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone! :)

This time we done some important rethinking of the arenas. 
Previously, in the beginning only 1 arena was opened. Others would open after winning a previous one. Now [b]ALL[/b]
 arenas are open and can be played without any limitations!
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/9f8938a13674b35ba359019186604fa126fe2306.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/e8f4c665f5cc390dc11852eb6ceaccd0e70a33f0.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/b1a1b21ebcac2799e571178eeee4f8eba2de5d45.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/f4ccdebe8924341363baecdd7c9b048459b29e01.png[/img][/url]
It is a great chance to play those arenas which were previously locked for you!

Also, many people said that they don't like screen shake. [b]Now this function can be disabled in settings![/b]

Also, now Pixel Gladiator can be played in Chinese! :)
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/649b3af13418f315547b91585fc43c0f617179d1.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26941642/bc27e26cfd031e5091e9c281403b1f463961f6a2.jpg[/img][/url]

Trailer has a small changes too. New version of the Trailer includes new content.

Thank you for your attention!)

Stay with us! :)
